annotations.title: Check email security (MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC)

description: Email Security score for a domain with the DNS records found and the exact records to publish for each fix.

domain.description: The domain to check, as the person gave it (no scheme, no path). Reserved names such as example.com are refused.

refresh.description: Force a fresh scan instead of the cached result (rate limited)

name: check_email_security

cache_age_seconds.description: Age of the result; 0 means it was scanned just now

items.description: One scored area of the domain

held_back.description: Points the cap holds back while a fix is open (89 cap) or a critical one is (69). Not taken from any component: sum(components.points) - held_back = score

null_mx.description: The domain declares that it sends and receives no mail

provider.description: Mail provider detected from MX; null when not recognised

raw.description: What the components add up to, before the cap

fix.description: The exact change to publish: a DNS record (name, type, value) or a file or tag (kind, label, value, where). Null when there is nothing to publish, for example "turn on DKIM in your provider".

records.description: DNS records found, keyed mx, spf, dkim, dmarc

report_url.description: The report page for this domain on astraverify.com

request_id.description: req_... for this call. Quote it when reporting a problem with the result.

score.description: Out of 100, exactly as astraverify.com shows it

title: Check email security (MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC)
